notes:
Prospect: mid-market SaaS platform for e-comm customer support. Primary ask = replace current bot + human-handoff flow with low-latency streaming assistant. Evaluating Hosted API first (fast onboarding) then Dedicated for predictable SLA. POC started 2026-02-20.

Key technical requirements: streaming responses with tool-calling (order lookup, refund, escalate), structured action tokens for UI (JSON actions), first-token SLO <1.5s median and 99th <= 2.5s ideally. Must support function/tool auth and telemetry.

POC observations: initial demo (2026-02-20) went well. Small-scale perf runs: median TTF ~1.2s, p95 ~1.9s, p99 spiky up to 2.8s during synthetic peak. Customer quote: "Streaming must feel indistinguishable from a live agent — pauses are very noticeable." They emphasized <1.5s for first token on normal load.

Security/compliance: requires SSO (SAML), SOC2 is mandatory, audit logs + retention controls, and a data residency question for EU customers (they have EU merchants). Legal asked for sample DPA and outline of where logs/embeddings live.

Cost & commercial: cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for dedicated if unit economics predictable. Interested in reserved capacity pricing vs burst. Asked for example ARR scenarios and per-conversation token estimates.

Operational notes: product team wants streaming SDK + example code for tool-calling webhook flow. Platform team flagged that automatic fallback to smaller models must preserve action schema. SE note: recommend KV prefix caching + RTT-optimized kernels, routing rules to fallback models in other region for capacity events.

Sales touches: AE demo (Maya) 2026-02-20, SE deep-dive (Diego) 2026-03-03, security questionnaire sent 2026-03-04, perf follow-up scheduled 2026-03-10.

Short-term next steps: extend POC 2 weeks with simulated peak (8k concurrent conversations), deliver dedicated 3-node pricing, provide DPA + SOC2 summary.

CRM style snippets: "POC looks promising but p99 spikes are the primary risk", "need legal sign-off on EU residency", "customer leaning Hosted->Dedicated if we can hit consistent <1.5s TTF"
